theme: Changeover day, one call, and Croatia five days out.
greeting: Moving day, Dan: out of Kenwood and into the St. Pete Ranch, with just the Brunswick call on the books. The girls are with you, and Croatia is now five days off, so most of the open week belongs to the trip list.

needsAttention.title: Pick a time for the Conor Kehoe call
needsAttention.detail: After you moved Friday, Conor's EA Kate offered Mon Sep 7 or Tue Sep 8 (9:00-12:30 EDT) and is holding the invite until you choose. This is the PRI intro Eugenia Jackson made for you.

needsAttention.title: Pack the travel larder bin
needsAttention.detail: Today is the Kenwood-to-Ranch changeover the bin was meant to be built before; it is the flavor spine for cooking across the rotating houses. Travel project, overdue since Aug 31.

needsAttention.title: Book the Sept 19 Cavtat night and transfer
needsAttention.detail: The last night after the charter, near Dubrovnik airport, has to be booked from land before the Sept 8 departure since the boat has no connectivity. Travel, P1, overdue.

needsAttention.title: Confirm checked bags in writing
needsAttention.detail: The issued Croatia ticket shows 0 checked bags; verify the allowance on Eurowings Discover and buy them online now if needed. Travel, P1, overdue.

needsAttention.title: Book the Sept 20-22 St. Pete gap
needsAttention.detail: You land TPA Sept 20 but the girls are not picked up until Sept 22, and those two nights are still unbooked. Travel, P1, overdue.

schedule.title: Kenwood to St. Pete Ranch
schedule.detail: Check out of House 1; move into House 2 through Sept 9

flagged.title: NACD New England prep session
flagged.detail: Larissa Ravetto sent the Oct 8 Zoom prep for the Oct 28 New England event, the director community you are leaning on.

flagged.title: C&C Sprayfoam estimate
flagged.detail: A $12,450 estimate came through QuickBooks to review and approve.

flagged.title: A sitter applied on Care.com
flagged.detail: Gabriella R. applied to your job posting.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and sale promos: Litter-Robot, Breeze, Mandarin Oriental, and the language digests.

recipe.title: Roast Monkfish
recipe.why: A firm, meaty fish that suits the cooler edge of early autumn.

tasks.title: Buy EU plug adapters and a US power strip
Book refundable Sept 20-Oct 5 car (decide by Sept 7)

acts.line: Check out of Kenwood and move to the St. Pete Ranch, larder bin riding along.
A half-hour Teams connect with Lauren Nadig at Brunswick.
Settle the girls into House 2, with Croatia now five days out.
